d:
Khelganv men jharkhand sthapna divas manaya ja raha hai. is aayojan men kaee stol lagaye gae hai. ismen se ek aakarshan ka ke dra bana hai jharkhand pulis ka stola. Rocket Launcher se lekar Sniper Rifle tak, pulis ke pas aise aadhunik aur ghatak hathiyar hain, jinki kshamta dekhkar aap bhi hairan rah jaenge.
Is khas vidiyo men dekhie jharkhand pulis ke pas maujud atyadhunik hathiyaron ki puri jankari. janie Rocket Launcher, Sniper Rifle aur dusre vishesh hathiyaron ki khubiyan, unki marak kshamta aur suraksha vyavastha men unki bhumika.
